public_rationale: On January 6, 2026, JLL reported average grid connection lead times exceeding four years in primary markets [e1]. This describes an infrastructure constraint, but does not compare September 2026 and 2030 costs for completing the same remaining construction work or operating the same GPUs [e1]. It provides no binding arrangements fixing those comparable 2030 costs, so neither part of the forecast is resolved by this evidence [e1].
limitations: The observation period runs through December 31, 2030, beyond the October 28, 2026 evaluation date.
The evidence lacks matched September 2026 cost baselines and comparable 2030 observations.
The claim does not specify locations, remaining construction work, a GPU operating-cost basket, or a material-decrease threshold.
Efficiency gains from newer GPUs do not establish operating costs for the same equipment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Incomplete AI data centers will cost as much to finish in 2030 as today, and GPUs will cost as much to run; unlike dark fiber, they won't get cheaper.

statement.excerpt: An incomplete data center will cost just as much to finish in 2030 as it will today, as will the GPUs cost just as much to run.

from_speaker: cost just as much to finish in 2030 as it will today
the GPUs cost just as much to run
our_interpretation: Today means September 22, 2026; in 2030 allows observation through December 31, 2030.
The plain reading in the stranded-infrastructure context is that waiting will not materially reduce completion or operating costs, rather than exact equality to the cent.
Compare the same remaining construction work and the same GPU equipment, utilization and operating service. Cheaper new GPUs or lower cost per token are different comparisons.
Use nominal costs because no inflation adjustment is stated, while reporting real costs as a sensitivity check.
No company-specific monetary metric is asserted, so metric_scope is null.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable 2030 evidence shows neither the cost of completing the remaining facility work nor the cost of operating the same GPUs has materially fallen from September 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence shows a material decline in either component. If one component holds and the other fails, report a mixed result.
